entities.summary: HD 37124 b is an extrasolar planet approximately 103 light-years away in the constellation of Taurus. The planet was discovered in 1999 orbiting the star HD 37124. Based on its mass, it is most likely that this planet is a Jovian planet. HD 37124 b is a exoplanet. Classified as Tier E (Oral Tradition) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
